operations.name: Anson K. Burrill

expected.charges: Appearing armed and disguised, under the New York anti-disguise law of 1845 aimed at the Anti-Rent "Calico Indians".

operations.research_note: Baker Chronicles printedp288 reproduces General Court Session27 p4 naming each prisoner as arrested March15,1845 and confined at Delhi. AHA1896 volI printedp166 image explicitly distinguishes these prisoners pardoned by Wright September1846 from Young January1847 group. Correct incorrect Jan27,1847 endpoint; retain month precision because no September day established. Existing biographies and all other fields preserved; their conflicting pardon sentence remains for separately authorized biography handling. No case notes added.
